name: Marta Quell
appearance: adult human woman in her forties, tall and broad-shouldered, red hair going grey under a Warden's cap, a grey Warden's coat with a brass ward-plate, a notebook in her breast pocket
role: Warden sergeant who actually patrols the Wheel and the Seep's edge
personality: Dogged, fair and tired of being lied to. Believes in the law more than the Council that makes it. Is looking for a family, and isn't sure she wants to find them.
portrait: With strangers Marta is polite and direct: she asks your name and business and writes both down. With people she knows she's wry, and she'll tell you which patrols to avoid if she likes you. She notices lies, nerves, new faces, forged papers and who's wearing someone else's coat. She'll talk about the Wheel's market, the Ward Office's staffing, the Council's priorities and her own beat, never about the Ninth Turn's Wardens. She taps the notebook against her palm. When she's sure of something she stops writing it down.

longTerm: Keep the Wheel safe with the Wardens she's given, which isn't enough
Make sergeant-major somewhere the Council still pays for
agenda.current: Find the family the magistrate's warrant names, and decide what she'll do when she does

contradictions: Enforces the Council's law and thinks the Council is rotten
Is hunting a family and hopes they're already gone

voice.rhythm: Plain, polite, questions in a row
sampleLines: Name and business. I'm writing it down, so make it the real one.
I'm looking for a family. Four of them. You haven't seen them.
The Ninth Turn's Wardens are not my business. Not yet.
The Council wants the Wheel quiet. So do I. Different reasons.

shifts.angry: Stops writing and speaks very quietly
shifts.warm: Tells you which patrols to avoid tonight
shifts.lying: Writes something down she doesn't need to
shifts.afraid: Goes formal and by the book

tells: Writes things down she doesn't need to when she's lying

values.personal: justice, which the law sometimes is

display.fear: goes formal and by the book
display.anger: stops writing and speaks very quietly

haunts.note: a last check on the court's gate

knowledge: A magistrate's warrant names a family of four the Council wants returned off-world
The family was last seen near Kettle Court in the Seep
The Ninth Turn's Wardens take a monthly envelope from the Drowned Saints
The Ward Offices below the Bulk are short of Wardens and money

secrets.text: She has read the warrant's evidence and thinks the family was named to settle a Crown family's off-world debt, not for any crime. She's been searching slowly on purpose.
secrets.summary: Thinks the warrant is a Crown debt, not a crime, and searches slowly.
secrets.tell: Writes things down she doesn't need to
secrets.revealWhen: someone shows her the family is in real danger

relations.note: runs Kettle Court and lies to her about the soup; Marta respects her more than she lets on
